descByPlatform.chatgpt: workplace safety poster for an industrial-facility signage program, 2:3 vertical wall-mount format. Subject: a bold centred iconography block combining a hard-hat silhouette stacked above an exclamation mark inside a triangle caution pictogram, flanked by diagonal yellow-and-black caution stripes running along the left and right edges of the frame, plus a small secondary pictogram strip of ear-protection, eye-protection and glove icons across the lower third. Typography: 'SAFETY FIRST' Impact 96pt bold all-caps in industrial black #0B0B0B centred at 50% x 18% y on a safety yellow band; instructions 'WEAR PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT AT ALL TIMES' Inter 20pt medium tracking-150 in industrial black at 50% x 72% y. Composition: Centered 50% x 50% y, Eye-Level 0° flat, hard-hat icon 38% frame, hero vertical. Camera: 50mm f/8 1/125s ISO 100 graphic reference study. Lighting: flat graphic signage lighting — even flood no shadows, hard 10° ink registration drop shadow on type only. Material physics: vinyl signage matte, hazard-stripe ink saturation, pictogram crisp stroke 4pt, grain-3. Palette: safety yellow #FFD100 40%, industrial black #0B0B0B 30%, hazard red #D00000 15%, steel grey #4A4A4A 10%, white #FFFFFF 5%. References: OSHA signage, ISO 7010 pictograms, Otl Aicher Munich. Exclude: subtle, decorative, low-contrast, amateurish, cluttered.
